reason: Shared quality and cross-layer review checklist for the final verification pass.
Review the complete event and state flow across Store, preload, HTTP, persistence, and service scheduler.
Check service protocol, ownership, recovery, duplicate protection, scheduler state, and fail-closed behavior against the executable contract.
Check typed failures, scheduler recovery, and secret-safe state exposure.
Check service isolation, default-off behavior, and required Go validation.
Check event attribution, bounded history, truncation, and no secret leakage.
Check Store runtime identity guards, service snapshot reconciliation, handoff barriers, and disabled-mode behavior.
Check that all bridge/status/event fields are shared, normalized, and compatible across fallback and preload.
Check TypeScript/build requirements and UI state placement for runtime changes.
